notes.title: Announcement of the Content of the Initial Release Version
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. After internal discussions and multiple optimizations of the plan, the content framework of version 1.0 of "The Unveiler" is as follows:

1. Adventure Mode - A linear map - grinding design. After the character clears the level, it can be unlocked to the Challenge Mode.
2. Challenge Mode - Incorporates light Roguelike elements (such as random initial Buff/Debuff, etc.).
3. Character System - Three operable characters will be available in the initial release version.

Multiplayer is still under exploration. It may be considered for addition if technology and time allow.
